articles.summary: Joe Cole and Ashley Cole’s all-new FA Cup podcast, Football’s Greatest: Could It Be Magic? has found instant success, with content from the show hitting a remarkable 12.6 million video views in just three episodes. The full podcast episodes have been streamed well over 150,000 times, with the show also appearing in the top 20 sports podcasts charts on both Apple Podcasts and Spotify.
articles.title: Joe Cole and Ashley Cole find football magic for Carling as FA Cup podcast gets over 12 million views
